intro: Swelling Forces is a quest in which Arbal commands adventurers from the Grove of the Ancients to cull the rising Stormscale naga occupying the ruins to the northeast. These cursed former Highborne threaten the woodlands by aligning themselves with the insidious Twilight's Hammer cult. Taking up arms against them is vital to protecting the ancient forest from further devastation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Steel yourself for your time in the ruins, young one... You will not be granted free passage there.
Scores of cursed Highborne, now known as naga, roam the once great city. Travel northeast and dispatch them from this land.
What they once were... Is no more. If they aid the Twilight's Hammer, they can bring only further pain to the forests that once gave them shelter.
War is what they seek, adventurer. War... Is what we will bring.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Do not fret, young one. To pillage one's own home for some dark master...
